item.title: Editorial Mei 2016
item.description: Dear Omni-Akuatika contributors and readers We are pleased to announce that we have now been accredited for 5 years by the Directorate General of Research and Development Strengthening, Minister of Research, Technology and Higher Education of Republic of Indonesia as stipulated from its decree No. 36a/E/KPT/2016.
